name: chief-of-staff
description: A Claude that acts like a real chief of staff — catches patterns, closes your loops, remembers your context, and tells you the truth. Includes guided setup to build your own persistent second brain.

plugins.name: chief-of-staff
plugins.description: Turn Claude into your chief of staff. A behavior layer (celebrate before you optimize, close loops, verify don't claim, surface forgotten commitments) plus /chief-of-staff:setup, which scaffolds a persistent memory + daily-brief system tailored to you.

plugins.name: household-chief-of-staff
plugins.description: A household chief of staff for a busy family home (kids, partner, pets), designed for a parent with ADHD, anxiety, and/or depression: external memory, three-things-max plans, a low-energy mode, no shame, and draft-never-send.
